name: AGEINT: Agentic Intelligence — A Modular Atlas, Library, Course, Textbook, Cookbook, and Playbook for Agentic Intelligence
description: A modular, evidence-bounded curriculum for Agentic Intelligence. AGEINT converts a verified source guide into a semantic manuscript, a registry-backed figure set, generated BibTeX, and auditable runtime variables across 16 parts, 51 chapters, and 9 appendices. All material is educational, synthetic, accountable, defensive, and bounded by legal and human oversight constraints.
